items.question: Who founded Ahrefs and is it still bootstrapped?
items.answer: Ahrefs was founded in July 2010 by Dmitry Gerasimenko, a Ukrainian software developer who funded the launch with personal capital. He is still CEO in May 2026 — a rare 16-year founder-CEO run. The company has never taken venture capital, has no sales team, and reportedly crossed $100M ARR years ago while operating from Singapore with ~141 employees across 26+ countries. CMO and product advisor Tim Soulo is the editorial face of the Ahrefs blog (one of the most-read SEO publications globally). CTO is Igor Pikovets.

items.question: What is Ahrefs Brand Radar and why does it matter in 2026?
items.answer: Brand Radar is Ahrefs' 2024-2025 answer to the AI search disruption. It tracks how often your brand is mentioned in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, and Google AI Overviews — using a 250M+ real-user prompt database across 5 AI indexes and 100M+ prompts. Why it matters: 16% of US Google searches now show AI Overviews (doubled since March 2025), and when an AI Overview appears the top organic result loses 34.5% of its clicks. Pure rank tracking is no longer sufficient — the new question is 'does the LLM cite us?' Brand Radar is the closest thing to a category-defining AEO/GEO tracking tool in 2026.

items.question: How does Ahrefs work for Indian marketers and agencies in 2026?
items.answer: USD billing only — no India-specific PPP pricing, no Indian Pvt Ltd entity, no GST invoice, no Input Tax Credit. Indian buyers absorb reverse-charge GST (18%) plus forex card fees. Lite at $129/mo lands at roughly ₹12,500/mo all-in; Standard at $249/mo lands at roughly ₹24,000/mo. items.question: How much does Ahrefs cost?
items.answer: Ahrefs offers a free Ahrefs Webmaster Tools plan with limited access to Site Explorer and Site Audit for verified sites, plus paid plans starting with the Starter plan at $29 per month. Core platform plans include Lite at $129 per month, Standard at $249 per month, Advanced at $449 per month, and an Enterprise plan starting at $1,499 per month with an annual commitment. items.question: What's the difference between DR and UR?
items.answer: Domain Rating (DR) measures the strength of a website's overall backlink profile on a 0-100 scale. URL Rating (UR) measures the strength of a specific page's backlink profile. DR is for evaluating sites, UR for evaluating specific pages.

round are not answer-bearing.
